name: The Uverworld Project
source:
The Uverworld Project is a horror VN with inspiration from films like The Silence of the Lambs. Who was behind the murders in the Uverworld project? We shall see...

[From [url=https://mindsalike.itch.io/theuverworldproject]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《The Uverworld Project》是一部受《沉默的羔羊》等電影啟發的恐怖視覺小說。究竟是誰策劃了Uverworld計畫中的謀殺？我們拭目以待……

[摘自[url=https://mindsalike.itch.io/theuverworldproject]itch.io[/url]]
